portfolio.stage.title: Selected Systems Work
portfolio.stage.intro: Three complex system cases solving distinct dimensions of complexity: rules, coordination, and human-AI workflows.
portfolio.item.1.role: Role: Product & UX Design · Business Rules Modeling
portfolio.item.1.title: Membership & Automated Billing
portfolio.item.1.problem: Complex membership cards, vouchers, and discounts caused cashier bottlenecks and compliance risks.
portfolio.item.1.decision: Key Decision: Structured benefits and automated billing rules to replace manual approval loops.
portfolio.item.1.cardDesc: Structured membership benefits and billing rules into automated workflows, eliminating friction and compliance risks.
portfolio.item.2.role: Role: Product & UX Design · Workflow Architecture
portfolio.item.2.title: Orthodontic Screening & Handoff
portfolio.item.2.problem: Isolated one-off screenings failed to capture qualified candidates across doctor roles.
portfolio.item.2.decision: Key Decision: Re-engineered in-clinic multi-role collaboration into a continuous tracked funnel.
portfolio.item.2.cardDesc: Re-engineered isolated screenings into in-clinic collaborative funnels with continuous tracking.
portfolio.item.3.role: Role: Lead UX Design & PRD Author
portfolio.item.3.title: PACS AI-Assisted Reading & QA
portfolio.item.3.problem: Image review lacked structured auditing, risking missed diagnoses and disconnected AI.
portfolio.item.3.decision: Key Decision: Embedded AI detection into reading workflows with lightweight doctor review and QA feedback loops.
portfolio.item.3.cardDesc: Embedded AI detection into doctor workflows with verification tracking and model feedback loops.
about.stage.title: How I Turn Complex Chaos into Systems
about.stage.intro: Starting from messy frontline realities, using a 5-step product thinking flow to converge ambiguous problems into reliable systems.
about.stage.step.1.label: 01 / Understand
about.stage.step.1.title: Go to the Frontline
about.stage.step.1.body: Deeply observe real workflows, role friction, implicit habits, and operational bottlenecks.
about.stage.step.2.label: 02 / Frame
about.stage.step.2.title: Frame the Core Problem
about.stage.step.2.body: Distinguish rule, process, and information gaps. Converge scattered complaints into actionable product hypotheses.
about.stage.step.3.label: 03 / Structure
about.stage.step.3.title: Model the System
about.stage.step.3.body: Abstract tacit domain expertise into explicit business rules, state machines, and permission boundaries.
about.stage.step.4.label: 04 / Validate
about.stage.step.4.title: Validate in Production
about.stage.step.4.body: Test interactive prototypes in live environments to verify usability and operational viability.
about.stage.step.5.label: 05 / Iterate
about.stage.step.5.title: Continuously Iterate
about.stage.step.5.body: Refine robustness, efficiency, and ergonomic clarity based on operational telemetry and feedback.
